column3: The automations on switch is a UI SDK Switch saved on toggle and driven by api.setChecked once it is enabled again; extensions/chrome.tsx Toggle stays for the Settings surface
column4: A disabled ui-switch ignores a checked write, and the switch is disabled while its update runs, so the answer has to be applied after busy clears; chrome.tsx belongs to the Settings surface
column5: e2e: Space and the menu's Pause each send one automation.update and the switch follows its answer
